physicalNotes: Radius 0.18931249 Jupiter radii from Hori et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..289H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract): 13,534.3 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Hori et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..289H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.02139519 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
